# Home

Sub-Saharan Africa's leading off-highway wheel manufacturer

 Titan Global Wheel designs, tests and manufactures the off-highway rims, industrial tyres and Tyron runflat systems that farmers, miners, construction fleets and defence forces across South Africa and sub-Saharan Africa depend on in the harshest conditions on earth.

 New release · NAMA X/T Series (NM-28)
 NAMA X/T Series

 The American Eagle Series from NAMA, distributed and supported in South Africa by Titan Global Wheel. A dual-sidewall on-/off-road light-truck and SUV tyre (NM-28) that pairs an aggressive shuriken, stick and shield tread pattern with engineering features that work as hard on the highway as they do on the dirt road.

 ✓ Wider running surface for more road contact, stability and reliable traction

 ✓ 3D siping for grip, traction, and better braking and turning control

 ✓ Right-angle shoulders that widen the running surface and give a bolder stance

 ✓ Stone ejectors - self-cleaning grooves that expel stones for consistent traction

 ✓ Staggered shoulder lugs for outer-shoulder grip, drainage and heat dissipation

 ✓ Dual sidewall - two sidewall designs in one tyre; pick your look

 OTR Rim Workshop

 NAMA X/T Series

 Dual-sidewall on-/off-road light-truck tyre

 The NAMA X/T (American Eagle Series, NM-28) is a dual-sidewall on-/off-road tyre with 3D siping, stone ejectors and staggered shoulder lugs - in 24 sizes from 15″ to 20″ wheels.

 Goodyear LSW®

 Low-sidewall stability, less compaction

 Goodyear LSW (low sidewall) technology pairs a larger wheel diameter with a shorter sidewall - lower centre of gravity, steadier road handling and a longer contact patch for reduced soil compaction on tractors, sprayers and wagons.

 Frequently asked
 Off-highway wheels, tyres and runflats — questions answered

 Quick answers for fleet managers, procurement teams and engineers sourcing off-highway wheel systems in South Africa and sub-Saharan Africa.

 What does Titan Global Wheel manufacture?

 We design, test and manufacture off-highway tyres, steel and aluminium rims, Tyron runflat systems (inserts and bead locks), and wheel accessories such as studs and CTIS. We supply complete tyre–rim–runflat assemblies for agriculture, mining, military and construction — plus an in-house OTR rim repair workshop.

 Where is Titan Global Wheel based, and where do you deliver?

 We are based in South Africa and supply the whole of sub-Saharan Africa, with a strong presence in the SADC region's agriculture and mining sectors. Contact our sales team for export enquiries outside the region.

 Is Titan Global Wheel ISO 9001 and B-BBEE certified?

 Yes. Our design, testing and production facilities are ISO 9001 certified and we are a B-BBEE certified supplier. Both certificates are available to download from the footer of this page for procurement and tender use.

 Do you repair and re-certify OTR rims?

 Yes. Our ISO-certified workshop repairs, NDT-inspects, pressure-tests and re-certifies OTR rims from 25″ to 63″ for mining, earthmoving and agricultural fleets - usually with a 5–10 working day turnaround, and at a fraction of the cost of a new rim.

 What is the largest rim size you manufacture for agriculture?

 We manufacture agricultural wheel assemblies up to 54″ in diameter - the largest in the region - covering tractors, harvesters, implements and irrigation equipment. Our steel and aluminium rims are available across the full Goodyear agricultural range, including the new NAMA line.

 How do I request a quote for off-highway wheels, rims or runflats?

 Use the contact form or call our sales team with your machine make/model, application, operating terrain, and the rim and tyre sizes you need. We will spec a complete assembly and quote it back the same week.

 Spotlight · OTR rim repairs in South Africa
 OTR rim repairs that keep heavy equipment working

 Our ISO-certified South African workshop repairs, re-certifies and pressure-tests off-the-road (OTR) rims for mining, earthmoving and agricultural equipment - extending rim life and cutting the cost and downtime of full replacement.

About Titan Global Wheel
 Not reinventing the wheel, just perfecting it.

 For over six decades we've designed, tested and manufactured the off-highway tyres, rims and
 runflat systems that keep agriculture, mining, defence and construction moving across the
 harshest terrain in sub-Saharan Africa.

 Who we are
 One supplier. The complete wheel system.

 Titan Global Wheel is one of the largest combined manufacturers and suppliers of commercial,
 mining, agricultural, earthmoving and military wheels in sub-Saharan Africa. We don't sell
 parts - we engineer complete, battle-proven assemblies that work as one system.

 From the family farm to the front line, our wheels are trusted wherever the work is hard and
 failure is not an option. Through ISO-certified design, testing and production facilities, we
 deliver shorter lead times, custom steel and aluminium rim specifications, and the after-sales
 support of a dealer network that reaches nearly any machine, wherever it operates.

 As the exclusive African distributor and licensee of the Goodyear
 agricultural tyre brand, we pair world-class technology with deep local knowledge - so the
 gear that feeds, builds and defends the continent simply keeps turning.

 Our Mission

 “To engineer the wheel systems that keep Africa's toughest industries moving - safely,
 reliably and on home soil.”

 Our journey
 Six decades of wheel engineering

 Milestones that built Titan Global Wheel into sub-Saharan Africa's leading off-highway wheel manufacturer.

 1960s

 Guestro Wheels

 Having started out as a rim manufacturer in 1965, the original Guestro Wheels business was a part of the Dorbyl Group.

 1980s

 Foundations in off-highway wheels

 Beginning decades of specialist design and supply for the agricultural and commercial sectors across Southern Africa.

 1990s

 Defence & runflat expertise

 40+ years of supporting defence forces begins - building the relationships and capability behind our military rims and runflat systems.

 2000s

 Mining & earthmoving reach

 A strong, sustained presence at major Southern African mining sites, with heavy-load rims and tyres built to last.

 2010s

 Global Wheel & 100% Local

 In 2012 our name changed to Global Wheel, the company became 100% local once again, majority Black owned and achieved a level 2 B-BBEE status.

 Today

 #1 in sub-Saharan Africa

 Exclusive Tyron distributor, Goodyear agricultural licensee, and the continent's largest combined off-highway wheel manufacturer.

 Agriculture
 Agricultural tyres that move modern farming

 High-performance agricultural tyres for tractors, harvesters, sprayers and trailers. Our range includes extreme flotation, LSW (Low Sidewall) and MFWD solutions that reduce soil compaction and improve traction across all field conditions. As a licensed Goodyear agricultural tyre manufacturer, we reintroduce this trusted brand to Southern African farmers — including the new NAMA line for light trucks and 4x4s on the farm.

 Defence
 Military Tyres, Rims & Run Flat Systems

 We have been a major player in supporting passive applications to the defence forces around the world for over 40 years. The undeniable and irrefutable quality and consistency of our products remains a hallmark of who we are. Our niche is our ability to design and test specific steel and aluminium rim requirements and manufacture small to large batch quantities that provides our customers with flexibility and shorter lead times.

 We have also strengthened our partnership with Tyron Run Flat Systems to become their distributor of Run Flat Inserts in Africa. This alliance together with various military tyre manufacturers provides us the ability to supply a complete Tyre, Rim and Run Flat Insert assembly.

 Tyron, the originators of the well filler band, have designed and developed a unique rubber run flat system for military and off-road vehicles. This patented system is a modular design and does not require a hydraulic press to squeeze the run flat into the tyre, making this the only field mountable and demountable rubber run flat system in the world.

# Accessories

Accessories
 Wheel accessories built for every application

 High-quality wheel components, rim audits and site severity studies — everything you need to keep your equipment rolling safely and efficiently.

 Overview
 Quality Wheel Components

 Wheel accessories are necessary to enable proper functioning and, just like steel rims, can be different to the equipment type. At Titan Global Wheel we fit high quality wheel components specified to the rim and tyre — ensuring safety, longevity and performance across all applications.

 Value-Added Services
 Beyond Components

 Our technical expertise extends beyond product supply. We partner with our customers to maximise equipment uptime and wheel life through preventative inspections and site assessments.

 Rim Audits

 Our trained personnel visit your facility to visually inspect every wheel. Checks include lock rings, gutter-to-lock-ring gap, flange condition, bead seat bands, stud integrity and lateral wear measurement.

 Site Severity Studies

 Quarterly studies for mines to assess all conditions that may damage wheels — pit area condition, road surfaces, debris, loading zones and dump areas. Our technical teams identify issues before they cause downtime.

 Troubleshooting & Support

 Our technical teams assist customers on site in troubleshooting wheel conditions, identifying damage causes and recommending corrective actions to extend wheel service life.

 Product Catalogue
 Haltec Wheel Components

 Explore the comprehensive Haltec catalogue of wheel components, valves and accessories — the industry standard for off-highway wheel parts.


# Runflats

Tyron Easyfit
 Runflat Safety Systems

 Specialized tyre runflat systems designed to keep vehicles moving after a puncture or blowout. Field-mountable without specialized tools — trusted by military, security, emergency and commercial operators worldwide.

 Overview
 Tyron Easyfit Runflats

 Tyron Easyfit Runflats are specialized safety systems designed to keep vehicles moving in the event of a tyre puncture, blowout, or other damage that would normally render a tyre inoperable. These systems are typically used in critical vehicles such as security, emergency, military, and armored vehicles, as well as certain commercial applications.

 These runflats are a crucial safety feature for vehicles operating in environments with a high risk of road hazards, including off-road terrains, hostile areas, or regions prone to deliberate tyre-spiking incidents.

 Features
 Key Features

 The Tyron Easyfit system combines innovative engineering with rugged materials to deliver reliable runflat performance in the harshest conditions.

 Safety Assurance
 They prevent a complete loss of control after a puncture or blowout, allowing the driver to steer the vehicle safely to a stop or a secure location.

 Multi-Piece Design
 The Easyfit system consists of a multi-piece construction that can be installed on most standard wheels without requiring specialized tools.

 Durable Materials
 These runflats are constructed from high-strength materials like polymer alloys, ensuring durability and resistance to extreme conditions.

 Bead Locking
 Tyron systems often include beadlock functionality, which helps keep the tyre secured to the wheel even when operating at low or zero pressure.

 Compliance & Standards
 They are tested and compliant with international standards, ensuring reliability in demanding situations.

 Benefits
 Why Choose Tyron Easyfit

 From extended mobility to battlefield-proven reliability, the Tyron Easyfit system delivers where it matters most.

 Extended Mobility

 Even with a flat tyre, the vehicle can travel a significant distance at reduced speeds, enabling safe evacuation.

 Versatility

 Can be used in a wide range of vehicles, from civilian to military applications across various wheel sizes.

 Enhanced Performance

 Reduced downtime due to tyre-related issues in critical operations, keeping your fleet mission-ready.

 Video

 ● NAMA X/T

 CW

 Crazy Werrie
 Featured rider · NAMPO 2026 launch

 Dual sidewall, one tyre
 Two looks. One tyre. Zero compromise.

 The NAMA X/T (NM-28) American Eagle Series is built around a moulded dual sidewall — two distinct sidewall designs cast into a single tyre. Flip the wheel on the rim and you switch from a clean, modern street look to a bolder, more aggressive stance. Same tyre. Same construction. Same warranty. Two personalities.

 "A dual-sidewall on-/off-road light-truck tyre that works as hard on the highway as it does on the dirt road."

 Distributed and supported in South Africa by Titan Global Wheel — an ISO 9001 certified off-highway wheel manufacturer with six decades of wheel engineering. You get the NAMA product, plus a South African partner who actually answers the phone.

 ✓ Two sidewall looks in one moulded tyre — no extra cost, no extra weight

 ✓ Aggressive shuriken, stick and shield tread design for on- and off-road bite

 ✓ Backed by Titan Global Wheel in South Africa — full spec sheets, dealer support, warranty

 ✓ 24 sizes from 15″ to 20″ wheels for SUVs, 4x4s and light trucks

 NM-28 · American Eagle

 Engineered for the bite
 Six engineering features. One unstoppable tyre.

 Every block, sipe and shoulder lug on the NAMA X/T has a job. Together, they give you the grip of an off-road tyre and the manners of a highway tyre.

 FEATURE 01

 Wider running surface

 More rubber in contact with the road means more stability, more traction, and a more confident feel under load — on the tar and on the dirt.

 FEATURE 02

 3D siping

 Multi-directional sipes that bite into the surface for grip, traction and better control when braking and turning — wet or dry.

 FEATURE 03

 Right-angle shoulders

 Square shoulders widen the contact patch at the edge of the tread and give the X/T a bolder, more aggressive stance on the road.

 FEATURE 04

 Stone ejectors

 Self-cleaning grooves that work stones and debris out of the tread as you drive — keeping your traction consistent, kilometre after kilometre.

 FEATURE 05

 Staggered shoulder lugs

 Outer-shoulder lugs grab the dirt; the staggered pattern also improves water drainage and heat dissipation under heavy braking.

 FEATURE 06

 Dual sidewall

 Two sidewall designs moulded into one tyre. Flip the wheel on the rim to switch from street-clean to off-road-bold — no extra cost, no compromise.

 Full size range

 From light-truck fitments to off-road monsters — find the NAMA X/T size that matches your machine. Radial tubeless construction throughout, 8 to 10 ply rating.

 Got questions?
 Frequently asked

 Quick answers to the things our customers ask most often. Need more detail? Our team is just a click away.

 Are Titan Global Wheel rims OEM certified?
 +

 Yes. All Titan rims are manufactured to strict OEM dimensional offsets and material fatigue standards, and are dispatched with an official Certificate of Conformance (CoC) covering material specification, precision engineering, and application durability.

 What is the typical lead time for custom mining rims?
 +

 Custom 25" 5-piece mining rims are typically delivered within 4–6 weeks from confirmed order, compared to 12–16 weeks for most conventional suppliers. Giant 57" and 63" mining haul truck rims take 8–10 weeks.

 Do you supply military-grade runflat systems?
 +

 Yes. Our Titan Runflat Systems are SANDF approved and proven in African peacekeeping missions. Available for 12.00 R20, 14.00 R20 and 16.00 R20 tyres, with run-flat distance of 50+ km at speeds up to 50 km/h.

 Which industries does Titan Global Wheel serve?
 +

 We serve four primary industries: mining, agriculture, military, and construction. Our range includes OTR tyres, earthmover rims (24" – 63"), giant mining haul truck rims, agricultural flotation tyres, and military runflat systems.

 Where is Titan Global Wheel based?
 +

 Our head office and manufacturing facility is located at 3 Bessemer Street, Heidelberg, Gauteng, South Africa. We supply customers across 8+ countries in sub-Saharan Africa, including South Africa, Zambia, Mozambique, the DRC, and Namibia.

 Industry Solutions

 Engineered for the toughest terrain on earth

 Titan Global Wheel designs and manufactures off-highway wheels, tyres, rims and runflat systems purpose-built for the demands of agriculture, mining, military and construction across sub-Saharan Africa.

 Agriculture

 High-flotation wheels for the field

 From tractors and harvesters to sprayers and trailers, Titan's agricultural range delivers low ground pressure, exceptional traction and long service life in the most demanding soil conditions. Our deep-tread bias and radial tyres, combined with precision-engineered rims, keep your operation moving through every season.

 Construction

 The home of LSW technology

 Rims

 Titan Global Wheel has a complete range of products from multi-piece 15" rims through to tubeless 22.5" single-piece rims in forged aluminium and/or steel. The variables are numerous, depending on the vehicle's application — offset, PCD, bore, stud quantity and configuration.

 Tubeless 22.5" single-piece

 Forged aluminium & steel

 Custom offset, PCD & bore

 All rims tested & approved

 Product warranty

 Explore construction rims →

 Tyres

 LSW® tyres — Low Sidewall Technology

 The construction market is where LSW Technology began. LSW uses a smaller sidewall and larger rim diameter than a conventional tyre while keeping the same outside diameter — delivering a smoother ride, less material spilling and improved handling. We produced branded LSW tyres for Caterpillar skid steers, and this success drove strong product development and testing over the following years.

 The origin of LSW technology

 Branded LSW tyres for Cat skid steers

 Smoother ride

 Less material spilling

 Improved handling

 Same outside diameter

# OTR Rim & Wheel Repairs

OTR Rim & Wheel Repairs 
 Restore your OTR wheels to OEM standard — without the downtime.

 
 Three decades of certified OTR wheel and rim repair for haul trucks, loaders and articulated dump trucks. Every wheel is sandblasted, inspected against OEM standards, welded, repainted and certified — with a 12-month warranty on the repaired area and a full report before work begins.


 
 Request a Repair Quote → 
 See the 5-Step Process

 MPI & ultrasonic testing

 57″–63″

 100%

 12-mo

 What we repair 
 Full-scope OTR wheel repair — sandblasting to certification

 Four integrated services, run on-site in our Johannesburg facility. We carry replacement components and parts so repairs stay short — most wheels turn around inside ten working days.




 
 
 
 


 
 Sandblasting & Inspection

 Every wheel is sandblasted to bare metal so the full defect picture is visible — no hidden cracks left behind paint.

 
 OEM-standard defect reporting with photos

 Fixed quote before any work commences

 Full dimensional check against OEM specs

 


 

 
 
 


 
 OEM-spec Welding & Re-engineering

 Certified welders re-engineer cracked, gouged or worn rim sections back to OEM geometry using approved procedures.

 
 Approved welding procedure specifications

 Replacement flanges, lock rings & gutter profiles in stock

 Certified welders with full weld maps

 


 

 
 
 


 
 MPI & Ultrasonic Testing

 Final non-destructive testing on every wheel — Magnetic Particle Inspection on smaller wheels and Ultrasonic testing on every circumferential weld on Super Giant rims.

 
 MPI on smaller OTR wheels

 Ultrasonic testing on Super Giant welds

 Technicians certified to industry standards

 


 

 
 
 


 
 Refurbishment & Repaint

 After welding and testing, every wheel is repainted to OEM colour and finish, then sealed against corrosion for the long haul.

 
 OEM colour match on request

 Anti-corrosion sealing on all surfaces

 Final fitment check before sign-off

 


 




 

 
 
 
 
 How it works 
 Five steps from quarry floor back to OEM standard

 Transparent, documented and customer-approved at every stage. You see the defects, the cost and the plan before we touch a torch.




 
 
 1

 Receive

 Wheel arrives at our Johannesburg facility — by your fleet or our collection service.



 
 2

 Sandblast & Inspect

 Bare metal, full MPI inspection and a photograph-backed defect report delivered to you.



 
 3

 Quote & Approve

 Fixed-price quote with parts, labour and timeline. No work starts until you sign off.



 
 4

 Repair & Repaint

 OEM-spec welding, replacement components fitted, repainted to OEM colour and finish.



 
 5

 Test & Certify

 Final MPI or ultrasonic test, full Certificate of Conformance and 12-month warranty.



 


 

 
 
 
 
 Who we serve 
 Repair lines purpose-built for heavy industry

 From open-pit mines to civil-engineering contractors, our OTR repair work keeps fleets moving across Southern Africa.




 
 


 Mining

 Rigid-frame haul trucks, loaders and ADTs on open-cast mines across Southern Africa.

 
 


 Construction

 Loaders, graders and articulated dump trucks on civil-engineering and infrastructure projects.

 
 


 Quarries

 High-cycle wheel sets on quarry haul fleets, including hard-rock and aggregate operations.

 
 


 Earthmoving

 Wheel loaders, dozers and large earthmoving equipment on bulk-handling sites.

 




 

 
 
 
 
 On the repair line 
 Inside Titan's OTR repair facility

 Photos from our Johannesburg repair lines — inspecting, sandblasting and certifying 57″ to 63″ IGLR Super Giant wheels and mid-size loader rims for fleets across Southern Africa.




 
 
 
 57″–63″ IGLR Super Giant wheels on the line

 Magnetic Particle Inspection (MPI) 
 




 

 
 
 
 
 Why fleets choose Titan 
 Six reasons mine and construction sites trust us with their wheels




 
 
 01

 Three decades on the line

 We have been repairing OTR wheels in Southern Africa for more than 30 years. The pattern matching between defect, weld procedure and test method is in our hands, not in a manual.

 
 
 02

 OEM standards, documented

 Every wheel is matched back to its OEM specification, with a documented inspection report, fixed quote, weld maps and final Certificate of Conformance.

 
 
 03

 Quote before we touch a torch

 You receive the photo-backed defect report and a fixed-price quote before any welding starts. No surprise variations, no scope creep.

 
 
 04

 Parts in stock

 We carry replacement components and parts so the necessary repairs can be executed in a timeous manner — no waiting weeks for a flange or a lock ring.

 
 
 05

 Super Giant capability

 We test every circumferential weld on Super Giant wheels ultrasonically — the level of scrutiny the 57″ and 63″ IGLR classes demand.

 
 
 06

 12-month warranty

 The repaired area on every wheel carries a 12-month warranty. If a defect recurs in the repaired zone, we put it right — at our cost. Read our latest repair stories &rarr;

 




 

 
 
 
 
 Frequently asked 
 Answers before you book the collection




 
 
 Which OTR wheel sizes can Titan Global Wheel repair? 
 We repair everything from mid-size loader and ADT wheels up to 57″ and 63″ IGLR Super Giant wheels used on the largest rigid-frame haul trucks. Our repair lines are set up for both light- and heavy-duty rims found across mining, quarrying, construction and earthmoving fleets.

 
 
 What inspection and testing do you perform before and after the repair? 
 Every wheel is sandblasted to bare metal, then inspected against OEM standards using Magnetic Particle Inspection (MPI) on smaller wheels and Ultrasonic Testing on every circumferential weld on Super Giant wheels. A detailed defect report with photos and a fixed quote is presented to the customer before any welding begins.

 
 
 What warranty do you offer on a repaired OTR rim? 
 Every repaired area carries a 12-month warranty, and a Certificate of Conformance is issued on completion. Final inspection includes MPI on smaller wheels or ultrasonic testing on Super Giant circumferential welds to confirm compliance with industry standards.

 
 
 How long does a typical OTR rim repair take? 
 Most OTR rim repairs are completed within 5–10 working days depending on defect complexity, OEM part availability and the testing queue. We carry replacement components and parts to keep turnaround as short as possible — ask about our emergency mining support.

 
 
 Do you handle collection and delivery of OTR wheels across Southern Africa? 
 Yes. We arrange collection and delivery across Southern Africa for customers with a fleet of OTR wheels and runflats. Our logistics network covers South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Zimbabwe, Zambia, Mozambique, DRC and Tanzania for haul-truck and loader fleets.

 




 

 
 
 
 
 Got a wheel that needs work? Get the defect report first.

 Send us the wheel serial, machine model and a quick photo of the damage. We'll arrange collection, sandblast and inspect on arrival, then send you a photo-backed defect report and a fixed quote — before any welding starts.

# Privacy Policy

Legal
 Privacy Policy

 How Titan Global Wheel collects, uses and protects your personal information.

 Privacy Policy

 Last Updated: 2026-07-15

 Welcome to Titan Global Wheel ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/

 Our registered address is: 3 Bessemer Street, Heidelberg - GP, South Africa

 1. Information We Collect

 We collect information that you provide directly and information collected automatically:

 Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, and other identifiers you provide when creating an account or contacting us.

 Usage Data: Information about how you use our website, including pages visited, time spent, and navigation patterns.

 Cookies Data: Data collected through cookies and similar tracking technologies as described in our Cookies Policy.

 Analytics Data: Statistical data about website traffic, user behavior, and conversion metrics.

 2. How We Use Your Information

 We use the collected information for:

 Providing and maintaining our services

 Notifying you about changes to our services

 Providing customer support

 Gathering analysis to improve our website

 Monitoring usage and detecting fraud

 3. Data Security

 We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

 4. Your Rights

 Under applicable data protection laws, you have rights including:

 Access: Request a copy of your personal data

 Correction: Request correction of inaccurate data

 Deletion: Request deletion of your personal data

 Portability: Request transfer of your data

 Objection: Object to processing of your data

 Third-Party Services

 We may share your data with the following third-party services:

 Google Analytics

 These third parties have their own privacy policies and we encourage you to review them.

 5. Children's Privacy

 Our services are not directed to individuals under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

 6. Changes to This Policy

 We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.

 7. Contact Us

 If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:

 Email: marketing@titangw.co.za


# Cookies Policy

Legal
 Cookies Policy

 How and why Titan Global Wheel uses cookies and similar technologies.

 Cookies Policy

 Last Updated: 2026-07-15

 This Cookies Policy explains how Titan Global Wheel uses cookies and similar technologies on https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/

 1. What Are Cookies?

 Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They help us recognize your device and remember certain information.

 2. Types of Cookies We Use

 Essential Cookies: Required for the website to function properly. Cannot be disabled.

 Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website.

 Functional Cookies: Enable enhanced functionality and personalization.

 Marketing Cookies: Used to track visitors for advertising purposes.

 Social Media Cookies: Enable social media features and content sharing.

 3. Managing Cookies

 You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

 Most browsers allow you to:

 View and delete cookies

 Block third-party cookies

 Block cookies from specific sites

 Block all cookies

 Delete all cookies when you close your browser

 4. Changes to This Policy

 We may update this Cookies Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.

 5. Contact Us

 For questions about our use of cookies, contact us at: marketing@titangw.co.za

 Welcome to the Goodyear LSW family Mr Lukas Erasmus from Kalkoennes Boerdery in the Free State.

## News article: LSW Technology takes on the toughest jobs — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/lsw-technology/

News › Featured Products

 FEATURED PRODUCTS
 LSW Technology takes on the toughest jobs

 Titan Global Wheel

 10 March 2021

 1 min read

 LSW® (Low Sidewall Technology™) helps equipment operators unlock greater productivity while taking on some of the toughest jobs in the world. LSW —a hybrid of our wheel and tyre technologies — features a larger rim diameter and a smaller sidewall than a standard tyre. This significantly reduces power hop, road lope and soil compaction, which improves equipment safety and performance. It also pairs well with equipment in several rugged applications, including agriculture, construction and mining.

## News article: LSW vs Duals: Choosing the Right Wheel Configuration — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/lsws-vs-duals/

News › Technology

 TECHNOLOGY

 LSW vs Duals: Choosing the Right Wheel Configuration

 Titan Global Wheel

 15 July 2026

 4 min read

 , , , etc. -->
 Choosing between low sidewall (LSW) wheels and traditional dual wheels is a recurring decision for farms, contractors, and haulage operations. Both configurations aim to put power to the ground, but they take opposite routes to get there. This article outlines how each setup works and where it fits best.

 What Is an LSW Setup?

 LSW stands for low sidewall. The concept pairs a taller wheel diameter with a shorter tyre sidewall. The result is a single wheel and tyre assembly that maintains a large overall rolling radius while reducing sidewall flex. In field equipment, LSW fitments are common on tractors, sprayers, and wagons where stability at speed matters.

 Because the sidewall is shorter, the tyre deforms less under load. That translates to a firmer contact patch and more predictable steering response, especially on hard surfaces and slopes.

 The Case for Duals

 Dual wheels have been the default solution for decades. By mounting two wheels side by side on each hub, the operator increases total footprint and splits the axle load across more rubber. This improves flotation in soft ground and lowers soil compaction per square centimetre.

 Wider total contact area for muddy fields

 Redundant support if one tyre is damaged

 Simple, well-understood maintenance routine

 Stability and Ride Quality

 At road speeds and on side slopes, LSW configurations tend to lower the effective centre of gravity. The reduced sidewall flex means less roll and sway during transport. Duals, by contrast, raise the outer wheel position and can introduce a slight lean when one side meets a firmer surface than the other.

 The best wheel setup is the one matched to your terrain, payload, and uptime needs.
 — Titan Global Wheel

 For operators moving between field and highway, the steadier handling of an LSW fitment often outweighs the extra flotation of duals. For slow, heavy fieldwork in wet conditions, duals remain a practical choice.

 Footprint and Soil Impact

 Soil compaction is a long-term yield robber. Duals spread the load across a broader swath, which can reduce pressure at the surface. LSW tyres use a longer, narrower contact patch to achieve a similar goal through different geometry. Neither eliminates compaction, but each manages it differently based on inflation pressure and axle weight.

 Configuration at a Glance

 At a glance

 LSW Single wheel, low sidewall, large diameter

 Duals Paired wheels, standard sidewall, smaller diameter

 Key strength Stability and road handling

 Key strength (Duals) Flotation and load spread

 Cost and Practicality

 Initial outlay, tyre availability, and serviceability all factor into the decision. Duals use proven components and are easy to source. LSW tyres may be more expensive and require specific rims, but they can reduce downtime by improving handling and reducing wear on suspension components.

 Ultimately, the best wheel setup is the one matched to your terrain, payload, and uptime needs.

 LSW
 Agriculture
 Technology

 TG

 Titan Global Wheel

## News article: New 51″ Mining Rims Shipped to Two Major Platinum Operations — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/mining-rims-51-platinum/

News › Mining

 Mining · Heavy Load
 New 51″ Mining Rims Shipped to Two Major Platinum Operations

 Titan Global Wheel

 21 May 2026

 3 min read

 Titan Global Wheel has completed delivery of 220 heavy-load 51-inch rims to two
 Tier-1 platinum operations in the Bushveld Complex. The rims are designed for 63-inch ultra-class
 haul trucks running at peak payload, where a rim failure can cost a mine upwards of R2.4 million per
 shift in lost production.

 Order at a glance

 Order specification

 Customer A Rustenburg — 120 rims

 Customer B Mogalakwena — 100 rims

 Rim size 51″ × 41″ (SDC)

 Tyre size 53/80R51

 Material Hot-rolled high-strength steel

 Load rating 101 000 kg @ 50 km/h

 Design life 18 000 operating hours

 Certification ISO 9001 · ISO 14001 · OEM-approved

 Delivery Q1 2026 — complete

 What changed in the design

 The 51″ mining rim programme was a clean-sheet design for Titan. The brief from the operators was
 specific: lift the load rating by 12%, drop the unfilled rim weight by 6%, and reduce the
 time-to-fit on a shop floor by half. The team's response was a redesigned spoke geometry, a new
 hot-rolled steel specification, and a captive-groove bead seat that speeds up tyre mounting.

 Pre-production prototypes were tested for 4,200 hours on a dynamometer rig at our Brits facility
 and across 11 months of in-pit operation at a partner site before commercial release.

 Why it matters

 A single rim failure on a 800-tonne haul truck can take a production line down for 8 to 14 hours
 while a recovery crew and replacement rim are mobilised. The direct cost of the lost production
 dwarfs the cost of the rim itself by a factor of a hundred. Designing for the worst case — a rim
 that outlasts the tyre, the haul road, and the operator's shift — is what mining fleet owners
 actually buy.

 For mining fleet enquiries, contact our heavy-load team at
 mining@titanglobalwheel.co.za .

 Platinum

 Titan Global Wheel

## News article: Introducing the NAMA X/T Series — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/nama-xt-launch/

News › Product Launches

 Product Launch
 Introducing the NAMA X/T Series

 Titan Global Wheel

 8 July 2026

 4 min read

 The all-new Titan NAMA X/T range is engineered to dominate both on and off the road.
 Across more than 40 SKUs — from light-truck fitments through to the largest 24-inch off-highway sizes — the
 NAMA X/T delivers aggressive tread bite, reinforced sidewalls and rugged durability for every terrain our
 customers work in.

 Designed at our R&D facility in Brits and validated across more than two million kilometres of in-field
 testing, the X/T replaces our legacy mixed-fleet platform with a single, simpler range that dealers and
 fleets can spec with confidence.

 What's new

 The X/T platform introduces three engineering firsts for Titan:

 Variable-pitch tread blocks — reduces road noise by ~4 dB at highway speeds.

 3-ply reinforced sidewall — improves impact resistance by 38% over the outgoing NAMA X.

 Cut-and-chip resistant compound — new carbon-black blend tuned for stony soils.

 Availability

 NAMA X/T enters phased rollout from 1 August 2026 , beginning with the top 12 sizes
 covering ~85% of Southern African fleet demand. The remainder of the range follows in Q4 2026. Existing
 NAMA X owners can continue to source replacement tyres through to end of 2027.

 For fleet pricing and full size availability, contact your Titan account manager or
 request a quote .

## News article: Titan Global Wheel at NAMPO Harvest Day 2026 — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/nampo-2026-recap/

News › Events

 Events · NAMPO 2026
 Titan Global Wheel at NAMPO Harvest Day 2026

 Titan Global Wheel

 30 May 2026

 3 min read

 Four days, 82,000 visitors, and one very large tyre. NAMPO Harvest Day 2026 was the biggest edition
 of the show in five years, and Titan's stand G7f was at the centre of the action. We showcased our
 complete agricultural wheel and tyre programme — including the largest 'agri' tyre on display in
 Southern Africa.

 What we showed

 The stand this year was built around three working zones. The first was the launch area for the
 NAMA X/T range, where the new variable-pitch tread blocks could be inspected up close. The second
 was a fully-assembled tractor wheel showing the Goodyear Optitrac tyre paired with a Titan DW
 rim — the same configuration running on a major commercial fleet in the Free State. The third was
 a deep-dive comparison wall showing the construction of runflat-equipped wheels, with cutaway
 examples for hands-on inspection.

 The NAMA X/T flagship on the launch wall — biggest 'agri' tyre in SA.

 A complete Titan + Goodyear agricultural wheel assembly.

 Stacked NAMA X/T sizes ready for dealer handover.

 The conversations we had

 The stand hosted more than 1,400 meaningful conversations with farmers, fleet owners
 and dealers over the four days. Three themes came up consistently:

 The cost of sidewall failures on rocky Free State soil — and how the new 3-ply NAMA X/T
 sidewall addresses it.

 Interest in the Goodyear Optitrac warranty programme for large-format fitments.

 Demand for our on-farm wheel assembly service — particularly among commercial
 planters with mixed fleets.

 Thank you

 To the farmers who made the trip, the dealers who flew in from across SADC, and our partners
 Goodyear and Tyron — see you at Nampo 2027.

 Titan Global Wheel

 25 June 2021

 Newsflash: out exciting new journey begins… The first stock has landed in South Africa: 13.6-24 and 14.9-24s. The Goodyear Dyna Torque II R-1 is an agricultural tyre specially designed for drivers who want excellent grip and superior traction.
The Goodyear Dyna Torque II R-1 delivers the performance you need to accomplish your tasks. It features a long bar/ short bar design which helps reduce the vibration, resulting in a much smoother ride. ## News article: ‘Off The Road’ to NAMPO 2022 — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/off-the-road-to-nampo-2022/

News › News

 NEWS
 ‘Off The Road’ to NAMPO 2022

 Titan Global Wheel

 11 April 2022

 2 min read

 Titan Global Wheel and Goodyear Agricultural go ‘Off the Road’ to NAMPO
 At this year’s NAMPO Harvest Festival, Titan Global Wheel will demonstrate an exciting range of Goodyear Agricultural tyres for farmers that reduce both ground pressure and tyre maintenance.
 Having reintroduced the Goodyear Agricultural brand into South Africa, Titan Global Wheel is gearing up to showcase a new range of tyres from the supplier, designed to make life easier for those in the agricultural sector.
 According to the company’s MD, Theo von Bardeleben, Titan Global Wheel will have a stand at the NAMPO Harvest Day Festival, which takes place in Bothaville in the Free State, from 16 to 20 May 2022.
 “Visitors will be able to view Goodyear’s new range of Low Side Wall – or LSW – tyres. Broader than most, these tyres are designed to deliver low ground pressure, ensuring that tractors and combine harvesters do not create deep channels or furrows in the soil,” he says.
 “From a Goodyear Agricultural perspective, the LSW range is a first of its kind, using patented technology to deliver these broad new tyres. Essentially, one LSW tyre with its rim can take the place of two standard tyres and rims. Not only is this more cost effective for the farmer, but it halves the amount of maintenance required, should a wheel have to be changed, for example.”
 “If we look more deeply into the exact benefits the LSW range offers, the compact side walls of the tyres help to reduce swaying and movement, as well as limit the damage caused to crops when harvesting. At the other end of the spectrum, when it is planting season, these tyres can carry the same weight at up to 40% lower inflation pressure, which is ideal for reducing soil compaction during this period.”
 “Of course, while these tyres have been designed with the agricultural sector in mind, there are many other industries in South Africa that would find the Titan tyre range beneficial. We can see enormous potential in other critical local sectors, most notably the mining and construction fields,” explains von Bardeleben.
 He further indicates that Titan Global Wheel will have Goodyear Agricultural offerings on show at NAMPO and invites customers to visit their stand at G7F, to discuss these products and benefits. He also notes that the company will also have a range of rims for the farming sector on display, along with experts to discuss everything from rim-related solutions to tyre-rim combinations.
 “We are looking forward to NAMPO and to seeing current and prospective customers at our stand. Apart from our new range of Goodyear tyres and the promotional opportunities around these, we will also have various specials available at the event and will run a daily competition giving away a series of prizes.”
 “We are extremely excited to bring this new range of products to our customers, as we understand the positive and potential impact these tyres have on the agricultural sector moving forward,” concludes von Bardeleben.

## News article: Steel bolt together wheels for military — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/our-exciting-new-journey-begins/

News › News

 NEWS
 Steel bolt together wheels for military

 Titan Global Wheel

 20 September 2021

 1 min read

 Steel bolt together wheels for military
 Here you can see our team at Titan Global Wheel assembling 20 x 10.00” steel bolt together wheels with the Michelin 14.00R20 XZL tyre for one of our OEM military vehicle manufacturers.

These assemblies are fitted with a special adaptor which allows the steel wheels to be fitted with a CTIS valve. The CTIS valve is unique as the driver of the vehicle can individually inflate or deflate the tyre depending on the terrain and surrounding areas. Tyres are deflated for more traction especially when driving through loose sand. The tyres can be inflated again on more stable roads.

The steel bolt together rims are specifically designed for military use. The rims allow easy fitment of the tyre and run flat insert or bead lock system in the field, without any specialised equipment required. It is a safe, strong rim without the locking and flange components that can dislodge during fitment or impact during operation. Titan Global Wheel supplies these rims in steel or aluminium.

 Titan Global Wheel recently installed its new Bouwa Variable Speed Drive Air Compressor.

## News article: Titan Global Wheel launches new innovative product range at Nampo — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/titan-global-wheel-launches-new-innovative-product-range-at-nampo/

News › News

 NEWS
 Titan Global Wheel launches new innovative product range at Nampo

 Titan Global Wheel

 5 April 2023

 3 min read

 Titan Global Wheel launches new innovative product range at Nampo
 Recognised as the SA suppliers of the Goodyear Agricultural brand of tyres and rims, Titan Global Wheel now also offers a range of Goodyear Lubricants, offering clients a genuine one-stop-shop.
 For the modern farmer, machinery is critical in delivering the agricultural output needed to be successful at scale. This is why Titan Global Wheel – providers of the Goodyear Agricultural brand of tyres and rims – has announced a range of Goodyear Lubricants , to further improve the operation and lifespan of this machinery.
 According to company MD, Theo von Bardeleben, the organisation has adopted a constant focus on innovation and on improving technologies that have been around for decades. Titan Global Wheel also works closely with almost all the major manufacturers, each of which places a strong focus on research and development.
 “We are proud to announce we have a new product line of lubricants designed specifically for the agricultural industry, such as for high use diesel tractors. These are all produced by Goodyear and will be available to the market from our warehouse in Johannesburg,” he explains.
 “This demonstrates our commitment to our customers, as it follows on from our reintroduction of the Goodyear Agricultural brand into South Africa last year. In this period, we have already had great uptake of our range of Low Side Wall (LSW) tyres from the same manufacturer.”
 He points out that LSWs are wider than most tyres, and have an increased rim diameter, lowering the tyre profile and reducing soil compaction, as it is designed to deliver low ground pressure. In this way, tractors and combine harvesters are able to avoid creating deep channels or furrows in the soil.
 “In addition, LSW tyres create improved traction, leading to longer tyre life and reduced fuel costs. With a single, wider tyre fitted where there are usually two, there are additional benefits like quicker time to repair, and a more rapid harvest period, thanks to the reduction in slippage these tyres offer to combine harvesters and high horsepower tractors.”
 “Thanks to our existing ability to deliver both the correct tyre and rim to a customer, added to our new range of Goodyear Lubricants, Titan Global Wheel is now in the unique position of being able to offer customers a one-stop-shop for all their requirements in this space.”
 He indicates that interest and uptake has been phenomenal, adding that interest remains high, as customers recognise – and have great expectations of – the strong product range the company offers.
 “While our new range of lubricants, along with the LSW tyres and rims, are available now, we anticipate making a big splash at the country’s premier agricultural fair, the Nampo Festival in Bothaville, Free State, from 16-19 May this year. Visitors will have the opportunity to view our exciting end-to-end wheel solutions and discuss with us how we can help them to boost their agricultural success,” concludes von Bardeleben.
 For more information about Titan Global Wheel’s products, please call Louis Enslin on +27 0 66 219 8286.

## News article: Titan Global Wheel repairs OTR wheels — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/titan-global-wheel-offers-otr-wheel-repairs/

News › News

 NEWS
 Titan Global Wheel repairs OTR wheels

 Titan Global Wheel

 20 July 2022

 1 min read

 Titan Global Wheel repairs OTR wheels
 Titan Global Wheel has been repairing OTR wheels for more than 30 years. Certified sandblasting and MPI testing onsite personal ensure that the wheels and components are inspected against OEM standards and recorded in a detailed report presented to the customer, showing the defects and costs to repair before work commences.
 Titan Global Wheel stocks replacement components and parts so that the necessary repairs are executed in a timeous manner. Once the replacement components are fitted, the wheels are painted and undergo final inspection which include, Ultra Sonic testing on all circumferential welds on Super Giant wheels, and MPI inspection on the smaller wheels to ensure compliance to industry standards.
 The repaired area on all wheels carries a 12-month warranty. Certificates of Conformance are supplied for each wheel.

## News article: Tyron Easyfit Runflats — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/tyron-easyfit-runflats/

News › Featured Products

 FEATURED PRODUCTS
 Tyron Easyfit Runflats

 Titan Global Wheel

 20 January 2025

 1 min read

 Tyron Easyfit Runflats
 Tyron Easyfit Runflats are specialized safety systems designed to keep vehicles moving in the event of a tire puncture, blowout, or other damage that would normally render a tire inoperable. These systems are typically used in critical vehicles such as security, emergency, military, and armored vehicles, as well as certain commercial applications.
 Key Features of Tyron Easyfit Runflats:
 Safety Assurance : They prevent a complete loss of control after a puncture or blowout, allowing the driver to steer the vehicle safely to a stop or a secure location. Multi-Piece Design : The Easyfit system consists of a multi-piece construction that can be installed on most standard wheels without requiring specialized tools. Durable Materials : These runflats are constructed from high-strength materials like polymer alloys, ensuring durability and resistance to extreme conditions. Bead Locking : Tyron systems often include beadlock functionality, which helps keep the tire secured to the wheel even when operating at low or zero pressure. Compliance and Standards : They are tested and compliant with international standards, ensuring reliability in demanding situations. Benefits:
 Extended Mobility : Even with a flat tire, the vehicle can travel a significant distance at reduced speeds, enabling safe evacuation. Versatility : Can be used in a wide range of vehicles, from civilian to military applications. Enhanced Performance : Reduced downtime due to tire-related issues in critical operations. These runflats are a crucial safety feature for vehicles operating in environments with a high risk of road hazards, including off-road terrains, hostile areas, or regions prone to deliberate tire-spiking incidents.

This patented system is a modular design and does not require a hydraulic press to squeeze the runflat into the tyre, making this the only field mountable and demountable rubber runflat system in the World and solves the logistical problems of current systems when changing tyres.

## News article: Tyron Field-Mountable Runflats: 40 Years of Defence Support — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/tyron-runflat-40-years/

News › Defence

 Defence · Runflat Systems
 Tyron Field-Mountable Runflats: 40 Years of Defence Support

 Titan Global Wheel

 12 June 2026

 5 min read

 For more than four decades, Titan Global Wheel has been the Southern African partner of choice for
 Tyron runflat systems — the only field-mountable rubber runflat in the world. From the
 mine-clearance vehicles of the late 1980s to today's armoured personnel carriers, the technology has
 stayed true to a single idea: a flat tyre should never stop a mission.

 A hydraulic press on the back of a recovery truck is a logistics problem. A runflat you can mount by
 hand, in the dust, with a spanner — that's a mobility solution.
 — Hendrik van der Merwe, Titan Defence Engineering Lead

 Why field-mountable matters

 Conventional rubber runflats require a hydraulic press to seat the runflat ring inside the wheel
 cavity. That means a flat tyre has to be recovered, transported to a workshop, and refitted — an
 operation that can take hours and a dedicated vehicle.

 Tyron's patented multi-piece design eliminates the press. The runflat is split into a small number
 of segments that wrap around the wheel and are bolted together at the roadside. A trained two-person
 team can complete the swap in under 30 minutes — with the tools that already live in any military
 vehicle's standard kit.

 What the platform covers

 Tyron runflats are currently specified across three families:

 ATR Insert Range — multi-piece inserts for 16"–22.5" wheels, load-rated to 3,000 kg.

 Bead-Lock Range — for bead-loss protection at low pressure or puncture.

 Multi-Fit Adapters — convert single-piece wheels for runflat operation without welding.

 Where they run today

 Tyron-equipped Titan wheels are currently in service with defence and security forces in South Africa,
 Namibia, Botswana, the DRC, Kenya, the UAE and Australia. Commercial applications include the mining
 fleets of Anglo American, Sibanye-Stillwater and De Beers — where a single flat in a remote pit can
 cost a six-figure sum in lost production.

 For defence procurement enquiries, contact our team at
 defence@titanglobalwheel.co.za .

 Tyron
 Runflats
 Defence
 Military

 Titan Global Wheel

## News article: Why Choose LSW Tyres? — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/why-choose-lsw-tyres/

News › Featured Products

 FEATURED PRODUCTS
 Why Choose LSW Tyres?

 Titan Global Wheel

 2 September 2025

 1 min read

 Why Choose LSW Tyres?
 LSW (Low Sidewall Technology) represents the next evolution in tyre and wheel design — built for demanding applications where performance, durability, and operator comfort can’t be compromised.
 ster wear. LSW tyres solve this by using a shorter, reinforced sidewall paired with a larger wheel diameter. This design dramatically improves stability, reduces power hop, and minimizes road lope — giving operators a smoother, more controlled ride in the field and on the road.
 Key Benefits:
 Improved Stability & Handling – Reduced sidewall flex means less bounce, sway, and vibration, even at higher speeds. Higher Load Capacity – Perfect for heavy machinery, agricultural equipment, and industrial vehicles. Extended Tyre Life – Enhanced tread design and even load distribution result in less wear and longer service life. Lower Operating Costs – Less downtime and improved fuel efficiency through reduced rolling resistance. Operator Comfort – A smoother ride reduces fatigue during long workdays. Whether you’re in agriculture, construction, or transport, LSW tyres deliver more uptime, lower costs, and a safer, more comfortable operating experience.

## News article: Why the LSW tyre from Titan Global Wheel is so Impressive. — Titan Global Wheel
- URL: https://www.titanglobalwheel.co.za/blog/why-the-lsw-tyre-from-titan-global-wheel-is-so-impressive/

News › Articles

 ARTICLES
 Why the LSW tyre from Titan Global Wheel is so Impressive.

 Titan Global Wheel

 25 July 2024

 9 min read

 Why the LSW tyre from Titan Global Wheel is so Impressive.
 The LSW tyre from Titan has been making waves in the agricultural industry for its impressive performance and durability. Farmers and industry experts alike have been raving about the benefits of this innovative tyre design, which boasts a unique low sidewall (LSW) construction that sets it apart from traditional tyre designs.
 One of the key advantages of the LSW tyre is its ability to reduce soil compaction, which can have a significant impact on crop yields. The larger rim diameter and lower sidewall height work together to distribute weight more evenly across the tyre, reducing the pressure exerted on the soil. This can help to improve soil health and promote better plant growth, which is a major selling point for farmers who are looking to maximize their yields. In addition to its soil-friendly design, the LSW tyre also offers superior stability and ride comfort. The larger rim diameter and shorter sidewall height result in a wider stance and lower center of gravity, which can help to reduce the risk of rollovers and improve overall stability. The result is a smoother ride that can help to reduce operator fatigue and increase productivity. Overall, the LSW tyre from Titan is an impressive innovation that is helping to transform the way farmers approach tyre design and performance.
 Innovative Design of LSW ty re Technology :
 Low Sidewall Technology Explained
 The LSW tyre from Titan features a unique Low Sidewall (LSW) design that sets it apart from traditional tyres. The LSW technology is a revolutionary design that significantly reduces vibration and increases stability, resulting in a smoother ride and improved handling. The LSW design features a larger rim diameter and smaller sidewall height compared to traditional tyres. This results in a larger tread area, which provides more contact with the ground, resulting in improved traction and reduced soil compaction. The LSW tyre also features a wider stance, which enhances stability and reduces the risk of rollovers.
 Structural Advantages Over Standard ty res
 The LSW tyre from Titan is designed to provide superior performance and durability compared to standard tyres. The LSW design features a stronger steel belt package, which provides better puncture resistance and longer life. The LSW tyre also features a larger bead diameter, which increases the contact area between the tyre and the rim, resulting in improved stability and reduced bead damage. In addition, the LSW tyre features a unique sidewall construction that provides improved flexibility, resulting in reduced heat buildup and increased durability. The LSW tyre also features a larger air volume, which reduces the risk of tyre damage due to impact and enhances ride comfort. Overall, the innovative design of the LSW tyre technology offers significant benefits over traditional tyres, including improved stability, reduced soil compaction, enhanced durability, and increased ride comfort.
 Performance Enhancements :
 Improved Stability and Handling
 The LSW tyre from Titan is designed to provide exceptional stability and handling, making it an ideal choice for a wide range of applications. With its low sidewall height and unique tread pattern, this tyre delivers improved stability and reduces the risk of rollovers. The LSW technology also ensures that the tyre remains stable at high speeds, providing a smooth and comfortable ride.
 Increased Fuel Efficiency
 The LSW tyre is designed to deliver maximum fuel efficiency, thanks to its innovative design and construction. The low sidewall height reduces the overall weight of the tyre, which in turn reduces rolling resistance and improves fuel efficiency. This makes the LSW tyre an ideal choice for fleet operators and other businesses that are looking to reduce their fuel costs.
 Enhanced Load Carrying Capacity
 The LSW tyre from Titan is engineered to provide exceptional load carrying capacity, making it an ideal choice for heavy-duty applications. The tyre's low sidewall height and unique tread pattern ensure that it can carry heavy loads with ease, while also providing excellent traction and stability. This makes the LSW tyre an ideal choice for agricultural and construction applications, as well as other heavy-duty industries. In summary, the LSW tyre from Titan is an impressive tyre that delivers exceptional performance enhancements in terms of stability and handling, fuel efficiency, and load carrying capacity. Its innovative design and construction make it an ideal choice for a wide range of applications, and its low sidewall height and unique tread pattern ensure that it delivers exceptional performance in all conditions.
 Durability and Longevity :
 Materials and Manufacturing Process
 The LSW tyre from Titan is made from high-quality materials and is manufactured using advanced processes. The tyre is constructed using a combination of rubber compounds, steel belts, and polyester cords. The steel belts provide strength and durability, while the polyester cords enhance the tyre's flexibility and resistance to wear and tear. The manufacturing process involves the use of cutting-edge technology to ensure that the tyre is produced to the highest standards. The result is a tyre that is strong, durable, and long-lasting, making it an ideal choice for heavy-duty applications.
 Tread Life Expectancy
 The LSW tyre from Titan has an impressive tread life expectancy, thanks to its unique design. The tyre features a non-directional tread pattern that provides excellent traction and stability on both wet and dry surfaces. The tread is also designed to wear evenly, which helps to extend the tyre's lifespan. This means that the LSW tyre from Titan can withstand heavy usage and still maintain its performance over an extended period. In addition, the tyre's construction ensures that it is resistant to punctures and other types of damage, further increasing its durability and longevity. Overall, the LSW tyre from Titan is a highly durable and long-lasting tyre that is designed to withstand heavy-duty applications. Its advanced materials and manufacturing process, combined with its unique tread design, make it an ideal choice for anyone looking for a reliable and high-performance tyre.
 Applications and Versatility :
 Agricultural Use Cases
 The LSW tyre from Titan has proven to be a reliable and versatile option for agricultural use cases. With its unique design, the LSW tyre provides excellent traction and stability in challenging terrain, making it an ideal choice for farmers and agricultural workers. One key advantage of the LSW tyre is its ability to reduce soil compaction. This is achieved through the tyre's larger footprint, which distributes weight more evenly over the ground. As a result, the LSW tyre can help to improve crop yields and reduce soil erosion. In addition to its soil-friendly design, the LSW tyre also offers excellent durability and resistance to punctures. This makes it a great choice for heavy-duty applications such as ploughing, tilling, and harvesting.
 Industrial and Construction Settings
 The LSW tyre is not just limited to agricultural use cases - it also excels in industrial and construction settings. Thanks to its robust construction and excellent load-bearing capacity, the LSW tyre is well-suited for heavy-duty machinery such as excavators, bulldozers, and cranes. In addition to its strength and durability, the LSW tyre also offers excellent stability and traction on uneven surfaces. This makes it an ideal choice for construction sites and other challenging environments. Overall, the LSW tyre from Titan is an impressive and versatile option for a wide range of applications. Whether you're a farmer, construction worker, or industrial worker, the LSW tyre is sure to provide the reliability and performance you need to get the job done.
 Environmental Impact :
 Reduced Carbon Footprint
 The LSW tyre from Titan has a significantly lower carbon footprint compared to traditional tyres. This is due to the unique design of the tyre, which allows for reduced rolling resistance and improved fuel efficiency. The LSW tyre has been shown to reduce fuel consumption by up to 5%, resulting in a reduction of carbon emissions. This makes the LSW tyre an environmentally friendly option for those looking to reduce their carbon footprint.
 Recyclability and Waste Management
 The LSW tyre is designed with recyclability and waste management in mind. The tyre is made from high-quality materials that can be easily recycled at the end of its life cycle. This reduces the amount of waste that ends up in landfills and helps to conserve natural resources. Additionally, the LSW tyre is designed to last longer than traditional tyres, which means that fewer tyres need to be produced and disposed of over time. In conclusion, the LSW tyre from Titan is an impressive tyre that offers many benefits, including a reduced carbon footprint and improved recyclability and waste management. These features make the LSW tyre an environmentally friendly option for those looking to reduce their impact on the environment.
 Maintenance and Care Tips :
 Keeping your LSW tyres from Titan in top condition is essential to ensure maximum performance and longevity. Here are some maintenance and care tips to help you get the most out of your LSW tyres:
 1. Regular Inspection
 It is important to inspect your LSW tyres regularly to ensure they are in good condition. Check for any cuts, punctures, or signs of wear and tear. If you notice any issues, it is best to get them repaired or replaced as soon as possible to avoid any further damage.
 2. Proper Inflation
 Maintaining the correct inflation pressure is crucial for the optimal performance of your LSW tyres. Overinflation can cause uneven wear and reduce the tyre's lifespan, while underinflation can lead to increased rolling resistance and decreased fuel efficiency. Make sure to check the inflation pressure regularly and adjust it as necessary.
 3. Proper Storage
 When storing your LSW tyres, make sure to keep them in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and heat sources. Avoid stacking them too high or placing heavy objects on top of them, as this can cause damage to the tyres.
 4. Regular Cleaning
 Keeping your LSW tyres clean can help prevent the buildup of dirt and debris, which can cause damage over time. Use a mild soap and water to clean the tyres, and avoid using harsh chemicals or abrasive materials that can damage the tyre's surface. By following these maintenance and care tips, you can ensure that your LSW tyres from Titan remain in top condition and deliver optimal performance for years to come.
 Conclusion:
 The Titan LSW tyre is a game-changer in the world of agricultural and heavy-duty tyres. Its innovative low sidewall design offers unparalleled benefits, including reduced soil compaction, superior stability, improved fuel efficiency, and exceptional durability. Whether you're a farmer looking to maximize crop yields or a construction worker needing reliable, high-performance tyres, the LSW tyre from Titan delivers on all fronts. By choosing Titan's LSW tyres, you're not only investing in advanced technology that enhances productivity and safety but also supporting environmentally friendly practices. With its proven track record and versatile applications, the LSW tyre is set to revolutionize the industry and become the go-to choice for those demanding the best in performance and reliability.
